name: Gonda–Ramnagar National Highway
significance: NH 330B is a branch of NH 330. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Gonda to Ramnagar, and it meets NH 330 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 330 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Shantipuram to Balrampur
